propositions: Recovery must classify and complete interrupted retirement operations where a binding identity appears both live and tombstoned without guessing across mismatched identities.
Create recovery logic must be extracted from BindingStore into binding_recovery.py while preserving facade signature, immutable keyed/keyless behavior, grace period rules, and three-miss retry logic.

Retirement completion classifier should only trigger when tombstone, live forward entry, and live reverse entry agree on exact local_id and Jira key; completion removes redundant live pairs while retaining the tombstone and is idempotent.
Any identity mismatch, corrupt live file, or replace failure must abort safely and retain evidence without guessing deletions.
Keyed pending recovery performs no search; keyless pending recovery still enforces both three-miss and 3600-second grace requirements, and one entry failure does not halt others.
Pre-existing create-recovery invocation gate remains UNSCOPED-passes-only with no write-bearing or scope condition added; automatic retirement completion invocation remains out of scope.
